meta.title: Choosing Request Condition "Material Creation" reveals Category and Subcategory fields

steps.note: Confirm Category is not shown before selecting the request condition.
Confirm Subcategory is not shown before selecting the request condition.

args.goal: On the Create Intake Request page, enter a valid Request Title, select Request Condition "Material Creation", and stop with the resulting form visible.

steps.note: Perform the request-specific setup and condition selection that has no dedicated catalog step.
Verify the Category field appears after selecting Material Creation.
Verify the Subcategory field appears after selecting Material Creation.
Open the Category dropdown and verify it behaves as a value dropdown.
Open the Subcategory dropdown and verify it behaves as a value dropdown.
